findings.issue: אֵין לָאִישׁ גֹּאֵל licenses “there is not, to the definite man, an anarthrous redeemer.” “al varón redentor” is one definite noun phrase, so the man is the redeemer.
Construct אֵיל before definite הַכִּפֻּרִים makes the ram definite; bare carnero does not show that.

notes: Repeated האשם, hophal המושב, both ל phrases, piel יכפר, and בו plus עליו stay open and matched.
